subject: Trial environment options, success criteria & kickoff
messages:
From: Emma Thornton <emma@scouthealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@scouthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial follow-up & environment options

Hi Soojin — thanks for the call earlier. We talked through a few possible hosting paths and I wanted to confirm a couple of items before we lock the pilot plan. High level: Scout wants to validate latency for clinical summarization, ensure no PHI leaves our VPC, and evaluate cost at 100 concurrent users over a 2-week window.

Questions: 
- Does the hosted API option support a VPC peering pattern or private egress for PHI?
- If we run a dedicated sandbox, what are the VM/GPU specs and expected per-token cost at the volumes we discussed?
- Can you share a short success criteria checklist we can use for our internal sign-off?

I'm looping in Procurement to get any required paperwork started, and we'll need an NDA/MOU before any PHI flows. Attach a quick one-pager if you have it.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Thornton
Product Lead, Data Platforms
Scout Health

[Attachment: scout-poc-map.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thornton <emma@scouthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial follow-up & environment options

Emma — great to chat, appreciate the clear priorities. Short answers up front then a proposed plan and owners.

Quick answers: 
- Hosted API: we cannot accept PHI through our multi-tenant hosted endpoint by default. However, we offer a hosted pattern with private egress + customer-managed KMS in our Redwood Private tier (VPC) that satisfies your requirement. For the pilot, that would be a VPC trial (private control plane) or a dedicated sandbox with strict network controls and an approved SOC2 attestation.
- Dedicated sandbox: typical starter config we recommend for the workload you described is 2 x A100s (40GB) with continuous batching enabled. Ballpark per-token cost at 100 concurrent users for the two-week window: we estimate $0.0025 - $0.004 per token depending on quantization and KV cache hit rate. We will run a short load simulation to tighten this.

Proposed pilot plan (recommended): VPC trial (customer VPC peering + private egress) for 2 weeks, with staged fallbacks to a pre-provisioned dedicated sandbox if any onboarding blockers arise. This preserves PHI isolation and gives realistic latency.

Success criteria (for sign-off):
- Functional: clinical summarization accuracy >= 92% F1 on your gold prompts (you provide testset)
- Performance: 95th percentile latency <= 450ms for 1k-token requests at realistic concurrency
- Security: PHI never egresses public internet; KMS-backed key control verified in test runs
- Cost: per-session token cost under $0.0035 at projected volumes (measured during load sim)

Immediate next steps / owners: 
- Scout (Emma): send test prompt set + example PHI data schema and the name of your KMS provider. (owner: Emma)
- Redwood (Soojin): prepare VPC trial runbook and a minimal infra checklist for procurement/security. (owner: Soojin)
- Redwood (Ben): estimate dedicated sandbox pricing and prepare a pre-configured AMI/tf module in case we need to fallback. (owner: Ben)
- Redwood (Marissa): book kickoff call and share the timeline template; collect any legal contacts for NDA. (owner: Marissa)

I attached a quick two-tab map outlining the roles and an initial timeline. If that direction works, we can tentatively schedule a setup call Thursday morning PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: scout-poc-map.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial follow-up & environment options — action items (internal)

Team — forwarding Scout's note and my answers. TL;DR: they prefer VPC trial because of PHI; procurement looped in. Please see owners above. I need: 

1) Ben: quick cost sketch for the dedicated sandbox alternative (A100x2 config), include expected provisioning lead time and an estimate for a 2-week reserved window + burst policy. Put numbers in the sheet and flag any licensing caveats.
2) Marissa: schedule a 60-minute kickoff for Thu 04/14 09:00 PT and invite Scout leads + security. Also drop a one-page VPC trial ops checklist (networking, KMS, route tables, firewall rules).
3) Karthik: advise on any model-variant fallbacks we should pre-stage (smaller quantized instance) if the full-sized model can't meet latency under load. List fallback versions and rough perf tradeoffs.

Deadline: EOD Wed (tomorrow) so I can confirm timing with Scout and Procurement.

Thanks — Soojin

[Attachment: scout-data-access-matrix.csv (csv)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial follow-up & environment options — action items (internal)

Soojin — quick economic sketch below, copying numbers into the shared sheet. Happy to expand if Scout pushes back.

Dedicated sandbox (A100 x2, pre-provisioned):
- Provisioning lead time: ~48 hours if capacity available; 5 business days if we need to migrate quotas with infra.
- Estimated infra cost for 2 weeks (reserved window + 20% burst): $18,000 - $25,000 (includes GPU, storage, bandwidth, and a small ops margin).
- Per-token run estimate (2-week run, expected cache behavior): $0.0030 - $0.0045/token (depends on quantization and cache efficiency).

Notes & mitigations:
- If PHI restrictions force VPC trial, add 2 engineers to support peering and KMS integration during the onboarding window ($3k engineer-days estimated).
- We should pre-stage a 13B quantized variant to keep latency SLOs when load spikes; Karthik can list perf deltas.

I'll slot time Thursday morning to review the numbers with Scout during the kickoff. Marissa — I can join the call for the pricing section.

Ben Carter
Head of Trial Ops
Redwood Inference
